method.collision: two distinct inputs successfully encode to the same output within one named scheme
method.rejection: unresolved/error is recorded separately and never counted as a collision
method.round_trip: decode(encode(input)) == original Unicode string, exact code-point sequence
method.normalization: downstream transforms are reported separately from native scheme collisions
